zh-CN.title: 长安
zh-CN.subtitle: 隋唐帝国的都城与三教交汇点
zh-CN.shortSummary: 长安把宫廷、国家教育、寺院、道观、市场和国际旅行者压缩在同一座城市中。
curatorialDescription: 长安不是三教和谐共存的抽象背景，而是制度、资源、权威和信仰网络相互竞争又彼此借用的城市空间。
地图中的位置采用真实地理示意；历史名称、机构性质和具体建筑位置需要随着时代与来源继续细化。
zh-CN.researchNote: 当前为历史城市级别的 Alpha 地点，尚未把寺院、宫观、国子监和译经场拆成完整 institution/place 对。

en.title: Chang'an
en.subtitle: Imperial capital and meeting point of the three traditions
en.shortSummary: Chang'an compressed court, state education, monasteries, Daoist institutions, markets and international travellers into one city.
curatorialDescription: Chang'an was not an abstract setting for harmonious coexistence. It was an urban space where institutions, resources, authority and religious networks competed and borrowed from one another.
The map uses a real geographic referent as a schematic. Historical names, institutional identities and building-level locations still require further source-based refinement.
en.researchNote: This is an Alpha city-level place. Monasteries, Daoist institutions, the Guozijian and translation sites have not yet been modelled as complete institution/place pairs.
